He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Florida State Seminoles men's basketball|Florida State Seminoles]]. ==High school career== As a freshman, Barnes played basketball for [[Cardinal Newman High School (West Palm Beach, Florida)|Cardinal Newman High School]] in [[West Palm Beach, Florida]]. He earned All-Area second team and [[MaxPreps]] Freshman All-American honors after leading Newman to a 19–8 record and the 5A regional semifinals.{{cite web |last1=Wagner |first1=Jodie |title=Cardinal Newman F Scottie Barnes transfers to University School |url=http://highschoolbuzz.blog.palmbeachpost.com/2017/08/30/boys-basketball-cardinal-newman-f-scottie-barnes-transfers-to-university-school/ |website=[[The Palm Beach Post]] |accessdate=January 21, 2020 |date=August 30, 2017}} After the season, Barnes transferred to [[NSU University School]] in [[Fort Lauderdale, Florida]], where he was teammates with [[Vernon Carey Jr.]], the nation's highest-ranked junior.{{cite web |last1=Dusenbury |first1=Wells |title=Top sophomore prospect Scottie Barnes transfers from Newman to University |url=https://www.sun-sentinel.com/sports/highschool/basketball/fl-sp-hs-scottie-barnes-transfer-university-20170814-story.html |website=[[Sun-Sentinel]] |accessdate=January 21, 2020 |date=August 29, 2017}} As a sophomore, he helped his team to a 36–2 record and its first-ever Class 5A state title.{{cite web |last1=Furones |first1=David |title=University School captures first state basketball title in dominant fashion |url=https://www.sun-sentinel.com/sports/highschool/basketball-boys/fl-sp-us-5a-bhoop-sf-20180308-story.html |website=[[Sun-Sentinel]] |accessdate=January 21, 2020 |date=March 8, 2018}} Barnes led University School to a [[City of Palms Classic]] championship and was named tournament [[most valuable player]] (MVP) after posting 15 points and eight rebounds in the final versus top-ranked [[East High School (Memphis, Tennessee)|East High School]].{{cite web |last1=Lammer |first1=Pat |title=University School upends No. 1 Memphis East in City of Palms final |url=https://www.sun-sentinel.com/sports/highschool/basketball-boys/fl-sp-uschool-bhoop-20171223-story.html |website=[[Sun-Sentinel]] |accessdate=January 21, 2020 |date=December 23, 2017}} At [[High School Showcase|GEICO Nationals]], he averaged 21.3 points and 9.7 rebounds per game as University School finished as runners-up.{{cite web |last1=Jordan |first1=Jason |title=Nike EYBL: Five-star forward Scottie Barnes still motivated by GEICO National title loss |url=https://usatodayhss.com/2018/nike-eybl-five-star-forward-scottie-barnes-still-motivated-by-geico-national-title-loss |website=USA Today high School Sports |accessdate=January 21, 2020 |date=May 26, 2018}} In his junior season, Barnes averaged 13.1 points, seven rebounds and 4.8 assists per game, leading his team to a 27–5 record and a second straight 5A state title.{{cite web |last1=Lichtenstein |first1=Adam |title=University School — again with Carey sidelined — rolls to its second straight Class 5A state title |url=https://www.sun-sentinel.com/sports/highschool/basketball-boys/fl-sp-us-5a-sf-bhoops-20190307-story.html |website=[[Sun-Sentinel]] |accessdate=January 21, 2020 |date=March 7, 2019}} On August 5, 2019, he announced that he was moving to [[Montverde Academy]] in [[Montverde, Florida]], joining top recruits [[Cade Cunningham]] and Day'Ron Sharpe, for his senior season.{{cite web|title=Chosen 25 forward Scottie Barnes will transfer to Montverde|url=http://usatodayhss.com/2019/chosen-25-forward-scottie-barnes-will-transfer-to-montverde|website=[[USA Today]]|last=Jordan|first=Jason|accessdate=August 12, 2019|date=August 5, 2019}} Many analysts regarded his team as one of the greatest in high school basketball history.{{cite web |last1=O'Donnell |first1=Ricky |title=Why Montverde is being called the best high school basketball team ever |url=https://www.sbnation.com/college-basketball/2020/1/21/21073999/montverde-basketball-roster-cade-cunningham-scottie-barnes-nba-talent-caleb-houstan |publisher=[[SB Nation]] |accessdate=January 23, 2020 |date=January 21, 2020}} Barnes averaged 11.6 points, 6.5 rebounds and 4.6 assists per game, helping Montverde to a 25–0 record with an average margin of victory of 39 points.{{cite web |last1=Divens |first1=Jordan |title=MaxPreps 2019-20 High School Boys Basketball Player of the Year: Cade Cunningham |url=https://www.maxpreps.com/news/Pe--2iLJfkuLqD7ecx_MOA/maxpreps-2019-20-high-school-boys-basketball-player-of-the-year--cade-cunningham.htm |publisher=[[MaxPreps]] |accessdate=March 30, 2020 |date=March 25, 2020}}{{cite web |last1=Divens |first1=Jordan |title=MaxPreps 2019-20 High School Boys Basketball All-American Team |url=https://www.maxpreps.com/news/nm9MAVtXhkuj_dSz8iO6PA/maxpreps-2019-20-high-school-boys-basketball-all-american-team.htm |publisher=[[MaxPreps]] |accessdate=April 7, 2020 |date=March 25, 2020}} He received All-American first team honors from MaxPreps and ''[[Sports Illustrated]]''.{{cite web |last1=Visser |first1=David |title=FSU Basketball Signee Scottie Barnes Reacts to Being a First-Team Sports Illustrated All-American, with Video |url=https://www.si.com/college/fsu/basketball/fsu-basketball-signee-scottie-barnes-reacts-first-team-sports-illustrated-all-american-video-highlights |website=[[Sports Illustrated]] |accessdate=April 7, 2020 |date=April 3, 2020}} Barnes was selected to play in the [[2020 McDonald's All-American Boys Game|McDonald's All-American Game]], [[Jordan Brand Classic]] and [[Nike Hoop Summit]], but all three games were canceled due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]].{{cite web |last1=Jordan |first1=Jason |title=McDonald's All American Game Cancelled Amid COVID-19 Concerns |url=https://www.si.com/college/recruiting/basketball/mcdonalds-all-american-covid19-coronavirus-ncaa-tournament |website=[[Sports Illustrated]] |accessdate=March 30, 2020 |date=March 12, 2019}} ===Recruiting=== A consensus five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]], Barnes is considered the fourth-best player in the 2020 recruiting class by [[ESPN]]. He is the most highly ranked [[power forward (basketball)|power forward]] in his class by ESPN and [[Rivals.com|Rivals]].{{cite web |last1=Reed |first1=Tashan |title=‘To me, he’s a no-brainer, high-lottery pick’: Scottie Barnes will arrive at Florida State amid a ton of hype |url=https://theathletic.com/1504812/2020/01/07/scottie-barnes-florida-state-2020-basketball-signee-ton-of-hype/ |website=[[The Athletic]] |accessdate=January 21, 2020 |date=January 7, 2020}} On October 14, 2019, Barnes announced his commitment to play [[college basketball]] for [[Florida State Seminoles men's basketball|Florida State]] over offers from [[Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball|Kentucky]], [[Miami Hurricanes men's basketball|Miami (Florida)]] and [[Oregon Ducks men's basketball|Oregon]], among others.{{cite web |last1=Borzello |first1=Jeff |title=5-star recruit Scottie Barnes commits to Florida State |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/27844828/5-star-recruit-scottie-barnes-commits-florida-state |website=[[ESPN]] |accessdate=January 21, 2020 |date=October 14, 2019}} = yes }} ==College career== On March 13, 2021, Barnes scored a career-high 21 points in an 80–75 loss to [[Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets men's basketball|Georgia Tech]] at the [[2021 ACC Men's Basketball Tournament|ACC Tournament]] championship.{{cite web |title=Devoe, Georgia Tech beat No. 15 FSU 80-75 for ACC title |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401301257 |website=[[ESPN]] |publisher=[[Associated Press]] |access-date=July 21, 2021 |date=March 13, 2021}} As a freshman, he averaged 10.3 points, 4.1 assists, four rebounds and 1.5 steals per game, earning [[Atlantic Coast Conference Men's Basketball Rookie of the Year|ACC Freshman of the Year]], ACC Sixth Man of the Year and Third Team All-ACC honors. On April 9, he declared for the [[2021 NBA draft]], forgoing his remaining college eligibility.{{cite web |last1=Staley |first1=Antwan |title=Florida State freshman Scottie Barnes declares for 2021 NBA Draft |url=https://www.tallahassee.com/story/nolesports/2021/04/09/florida-state-freshman-scottie-barnes-declares-2021-nba-draft/7166879002/ |website=[[Tallahassee Democrat]] |access-date=July 21, 2021 |date=April 9, 2021}} ==National team career== Barnes won a gold medal with the United States at the [[2017 FIBA Under-16 Americas Championship]] in [[Formosa, Argentina]] after averaging 9.8 points, 3.2 rebounds and 2.4 steals per game.{{cite web |last1=Wagner |first1=Jodie |title=Newman’s Scottie Barnes basks in golden moment with USA Basketball |url=https://www.palmbeachpost.com/sports/high-school/newman-scottie-barnes-basks-golden-moment-with-usa-basketball/ceBdJ39JxPVT7HP6afILDK/ |website=[[The Palm Beach Post]] |accessdate=January 26, 2020 |date=June 28, 2017}} In a semifinal win over [[Argentina national under-17 basketball team|Argentina]], he led all scorers with 20 points and six steals while breaking the American under-16 record for [[free throw]] percentage by shooting 8-of-8 from the free throw line.{{cite web |last1=Benjamin |first1=Daniel |title=FIBA Americas Championship: 2020 prospect Scottie Barnes sets U16 free throw record |url=https://bustingbrackets.com/2017/06/18/fiba-americas-championship-2020-prospect-scottie-barnes-sets-u16-free-throw-record/ |website=Busting Brackets |accessdate=January 26, 2020 |date=June 18, 2017}} At the [[2018 FIBA Under-17 Basketball World Cup|2018 FIBA Under-17 World Cup]] in Argentina, Barnes averaged 9.5 points and 5.8 rebounds per game and captured another gold medal. He averaged 9.7 points, 4.9 rebounds and 2.7 assists per game at the [[2019 FIBA Under-19 Basketball World Cup|2019 FIBA Under-19 World Cup]] in [[Heraklion]], Greece, where he won his third gold medal with the [[United States men's national under-19 basketball team|United States]].{{cite web |last1=Boone |first1=Kyle |title=USA U19 men's basketball team defeats Mali in World Cup final to win gold medal |url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/usa-u19-mens-basketball-team-defeats-mali-in-world-cup-final-to-win-gold-medal/ |website=[[CBS Sports]] |accessdate=January 26, 2020 |date=July 7, 2019}} ==Career statistics== {{NBA player statistics legend}} ===College=== {{NBA player statistics start}} |- | style="text-align:left;"| [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2020–21]] | style="text-align:left;"| [[2020–21 Florida State Seminoles men's basketball team|Florida State]] | 24 || 7 || 24.8 || .503 || .275 || .621 || 4.0 || 4.1 || 1.5 || .5 || 10.3 {{S-end}} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *[https://seminoles.com/sports/basketball/roster/scottie-barnes/ Florida State Seminoles bio] *[https://mvasports.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/scottie--barnes/1380 Montverde Academy Eagles bio] *[https://www.usab.com/basketball/players/mens/b/barnes-scottie.aspx USA Basketball bio] {{DEFAULTSORT:Barnes, Scottie}} [[Category:2001 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:American men's basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball players from Florida]] [[Category:Florida State Seminoles men's basketball players]] [[Category:McDonald's High School All-Americans]] [[Category:Montverde Academy alumni]] [[Category:People from West Palm Beach, Florida]] [[Category:Power forwards (basketball)]]
